item.title: Port St. Lucie teen to serve as flag bearer at FIFA World Cup finals
item.description: Enrique Rosario Liz was surprised at the Boys & Girls Club of St. Lucie County in Fort Pierce with news that he will serve as an official Coca-Cola flag bearer at the FIFA World Cup finals on July 19.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with panoramic views
item.description: Built in 1860, the Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse has guided ships along Florida's Atlantic coast for more than 165 years. The 105-step climb to the top rewards visitors with breathtaking views of the Atlantic Ocean, Jupiter Inlet, and Loxahatchee and Indian rivers.

item.title: Linda Noskova recovers from match point collapse to win Wimbledon
item.description: Linda Noskova overcame a second-set meltdown in which she wasted five match points to defeat Karolina Muchova 6-2, 5-7, 6-3 in an all-Czech final on Saturday for her first Grand Slam trophy.

item.title: Park Vista Community High School football team aims for state playoffs this season
item.description: Park Vista Community High School's football team is building on momentum from winning four of its last five games in 2025 as the Cobras set their sights on the state playoffs in 2026.

item.title: US star Christian Pulisic fractured leg in World Cup loss to Belgium
item.description: Christian Pulisic fractured his right leg during the Americans' World Cup loss to Belgium and will be sidelined for several weeks, a person familiar with the injury said Thursday.

item.title: Florida families can save hundreds during 32-day back-to-school sales tax holiday starting July 20
item.description: Florida's annual back-to-school sales tax holiday runs from July 20 through Aug. 20, offering 32 days of tax-free shopping on clothing, school supplies, and computers.

item.title: South Florida immigration attorneys report shift in enforcement tactics following Homeland Security leadership change
item.description: Immigration attorneys in South Florida say they are seeing more traffic-related detentions and fewer high-profile raids since Markwayne Mullin replaced Kristi Noem as Homeland Security Secretary in March.

item.description: Port St. Lucie SC released new renderings of its 6,000-seat stadium this week, with groundbreaking anticipated in November at the Walton & One development along U.S. 1 and Walton Road.
